folded.id: bonna benkanankana|mu|maaso g'amateeka era bateekwa okukuumibwa amateeka awatali kusosola
folded.subject: bonna benkanankana
folded.object: maaso g'amateeka era bateekwa okukuumibwa amateeka awatali kusosola

spans.text: Abantu bonna benkanankana mu maaso g'amateeka era bateekwa okukuumibwa amateeka awatali kusosola.

folded.id: bonna wonna|mu|nsi
folded.subject: BONNA WONNA

spans.text: Olwekyo, Olukiiko ttabamiruka (General Assembly) olw'amawanga Amagatte, iulangirira Ekirangiriro EKIFUGA EDDEMBE LY'ABANTU BONNA WONNA MU NSI.

folded.id: buli mukozi|ateekwa|okussasulwa empeera entuufu emuggyamu
folded.subject: Buli mukozi

spans.text: Buli mukozi ateekwa okussasulwa empeera entuufu emuggyamu, emusobozesa ye yennyini n'abantu ab'amaka ge okweyimirizawo nga abantu balamu.

folded.id: buli muntu|ateekwa|okubeerawo nga mulamu nga yegazaanya awatali kutaataganyizibwa mu ngeri yonna
folded.subject: Buli muntu
folded.object: okubeerawo nga mulamu nga yegazaanya awatali kutaataganyizibwa mu ngeri yonna

spans.text: Buli muntu ateekwa okubeerawo nga mulamu nga yegazaanya awatali kutaataganyizibwa mu ngeri yonna.
Buli muntu ateekwa okukkirizibwa okutwala ensonga ze mu mbuga entuufu ez'eggwanga zikolebweko singa nga eddembe lyerimuweebwa mu Constitution ne mu mateeka liba lijolongeddwa.
Buli muntu ateekwa okukuumibwa amateeka aleme kutaataaganyizibwa oba okulumbibwa mu ngeri eyo.

folded.id: buli muntu|ateekwa|okufuna eggwanga ettongole gyabalirwa ng'omutuuze
folded.subject: Buli muntu

spans.text: Buli muntu ateekwa okufuna eggwanga ettongole gyabalirwa ng'omutuuze.

folded.id: bw'abaddu tebukirizibwa|mu|nsi
folded.subject: bw'abaddu tebukirizibwa

spans.text: Tewali muntu assanidde kufugibwa buddu, obuddu n'obusuubuzi bw'abaddu tebukirizibwa mu nsi.

folded.id: bwe okubugya|mu|ggwanga erimu okubuuza mu ddala
folded.subject: bwe okubugya

spans.text: Tewali muntu yenna anagyibwangako obutuuza bw'eggwanga lye wadde okugaanibwa okukyusa obutuuze bwe okubugya mu ggwanga erimu okubuuza mu ddala.

folded.id: ebintu bye|mu|ngeri etagoberera matteka
folded.subject: ebintu bye

spans.text: Tewali muntu yenna anaggyibwangako ebintu bye mu ngeri etagoberera matteka.

folded.id: ebitayinza kwewalika|mu|kukulakulana kuno
folded.subject: ebitayinza kwewalika

spans.text: Kino kimusobozese okutuuka ku biruubirirwa eby'ekitiibwa by'obuntun'okulongongoosa empisa ze, okuyita mu kukola kw'eggwanga lye oba okukolagana n'awamanga nga amalala, okusinziira ku nteekateeka n'enkozesa 'obugagga bwe'eggwanga mu by'enfuna, ey'embeera z'abantu n'eby'obuwangwa ebitayinza kwewalika mu kukulakulana kuno.

folded.id: eryo gerwako|mu|kiwandiiko kino awatali kusolola kwona okw'engeri yonna okuyinza okusinziira ku:- ggwanga
folded.subject: eryo gerwako
folded.object: KIWANDIIKO kino awatali kusolola kwona okw'engeri yonna okuyinza okusinziira ku:- ggwanga

spans.text: Buli muntu agwana afune eddembe eryo gerwako mu KIWANDIIKO kino awatali kusolola kwona okw'engeri yonna okuyinza okusinziira ku:- ggwanga, langi y'olususu okuba omusajja oba mukazi, olulimi, eddini endowooza ye ku by'obufuzi oba ekintu ekirala ensi oba abantu mwasibuka, ebintu byalina obuzaale bwe oba ensonga endala yonna.

folded.id: kikulu nnyo|mu|kutuukiriza obweyamo obwo mubujjuvu
folded.subject: kikulu nnyo

spans.text: Okutegeera obulungi obuyinza (rughts) n'eddembe ly'obuntu kikulu nnyo mu kutuukiriza obweyamo obwo mubujjuvu.

folded.id: ky'amawanga amagattere|mu|kukubiriza abantu abali okussamu ekitiibwa n'okukuuma eddembe ly'obuntu n'emisingi gyalyo
folded.subject: ky'Amawanga Amagattere
folded.object: kukubiriza abantu abali okussamu ekitiibwa n'okukuuma eddembe ly'obuntu n'emisingi gyalyo

spans.text: Amawanga g'amemba geeyamye okukolaganira awamu n'ekibiina ky'Amawanga Amagattere mu kukubiriza abantu abali okussamu ekitiibwa n'okukuuma eddembe ly'obuntu n'emisingi gyalyo.

folded.id: kyokka nga|mu|kiseera ekyo ekikolwa kyeyakola oba kyeyalemwa okukola kyali tekittekwa kumubonerezesa
folded.subject: kyokka nga
folded.object: kiseera ekyo ekikolwa kyeyakola oba kyeyalemwa okukola kyali tekittekwa kumubonerezesa

spans.text: Tewali muntu n'omu anabalibwanga nga azzizza omusango ogumubonerezesa, kino nga kisinzira kukikolwa kye yakola oba kyatakola, mu kiseera ekyemabega, kyokka nga mu kiseera ekyo ekikolwa kyeyakola oba kyeyalemwa okukola kyali tekittekwa kumubonerezesa, okusinziira mu mateeka g'eggwanga eryo oba ag'amawanga amalala Bwanabanga ateekwa okubonerezebwa mu kiseera weyazziza omusango ogwo.

folded.id: lwatu oba|mu|kyama
folded.subject: lwatu oba

spans.text: Eddembe lino lizingiramu obuyinza okukyusa eddini oba enzikiriza ye, n'obuyinza obubwe ku lulwe oba wamu n'abantu abalala, mu lwatu oba mu kyama, okwolesa eddini oba enzikiriza ye, ngayigiriza oba ngateeka mu nkola eddini ye byemulagira, nga asinza oba ngakuuma byemugamba.

folded.id: n'ebirowoozo okuyita|mu|mikutu gyonnna watali kukomerwa
folded.subject: n'ebirowoozo okuyita

spans.text: Eddembe lino lizingiramu n'ebeetu ery'okugugubira ku ndowooza ye awatali kitaattaagaayizibwa, okusaka okufuna wamu n'okusaasaanya amawulire n'ebirowoozo okuyita mu mikutu gyonnna watali kukomerwa.

folded.id: nga bwekikkiririza|mu|ddembe ly'obuntu era ne mu kittibwa n'omuwendo gw'omuntu era kimaliridde okukubiriza abantu okugenda mu maaso n'okulwanyisa omutindo gw'embeera y'obulamu bwabwe mu ddembe erisingawo
folded.subject: nga bwekikkiririza
folded.object: ddembe ly'obuntu era ne mu kittibwa n'omuwendo gw'omuntu era kimaliridde okukubiriza abantu okugenda mu maaso n'okulwanyisa omutindo gw'embeera y'obulamu bwabwe mu ddembe erisingawo

spans.text: Ekibiina ky'amawanga amagatte, mu kiwandiiko kyakyo kikakasa nga bwekikkiririza mu ddembe ly'obuntu era ne mu kittibwa n'omuwendo gw'omuntu era kimaliridde okukubiriza abantu okugenda mu maaso n'okulwanyisa omutindo gw'embeera y'obulamu bwabwe mu ddembe erisingawo.

folded.id: nga yeetabye|ne|n'abantu abalala
folded.subject: nga yeetabye

spans.text: Buli muntu waddembe okwefunira ebintu bye kululwe oba nga yeetabye ne n'abantu abalala.

folded.id: oba ngateeka|mu|nkola eddini ye byemulagira
folded.subject: oba ngateeka

spans.text: Eddembe lino lizingiramu obuyinza okukyusa eddini oba enzikiriza ye, n'obuyinza obubwe ku lulwe oba wamu n'abantu abalala, mu lwatu oba mu kyama, okwolesa eddini oba enzikiriza ye, ngayigiriza oba ngateeka mu nkola eddini ye byemulagira, nga asinza oba ngakuuma byemugamba.

folded.id: oba okuyisibwa|mu|ngeri eteri ya buntu emutyoboola
folded.subject: oba okuyisibwa

spans.text: Tewali muntu asanidde, kutulugunnyizibwa okubonerezebwa oba okuyisibwa mu ngeri eteri ya buntu emutyoboola.
Tewali muntu anakwatibwanga oba okusibibwanga oba okusibibwa oba okuwangangusibwa mu ngeri etegoberera mateeka.
Eddembe ly'omuntu yenna eyo gyabera amaka ge era n'ebbaluwa ze tebitaataganyizzibwe nga oba okwazibwa mu ngeri etegoberera mateeka, so n'erinnya lye teriweebuulwenga oba okulebulwa.

folded.id: obufutyanka ekiwandiiko|kino|oba obubawaliirizza okusosola mu ngeri eyo
folded.subject: obufutyanka EKIWANDIIKO
folded.object: oba obubawaliirizza okusosola mu ngeri eyo

spans.text: Abantu bonna bateekwa kukumibwa kyenkanyi eri obusosoze obufutyanka EKIWANDIIKO kino oba obubawaliirizza okusosola mu ngeri eyo.

folded.id: obuyinza okutuula|ne|bantu banne ngatebenkedde mu ddembe
folded.subject: obuyinza okutuula

spans.text: Buli muntu wa ggwanga alina obuyinza okutuula ne bantu banne ngatebenkedde mu ddembe.

folded.id: obwenkanya n'emirembe|mu|nsi
folded.subject: obwenkanya n'emirembe

spans.text: Ekitiibwa ky'omuntu eky'obutonde; okwenkanankana, wamu n'obuyinza obutayinza kugyibwawo ebyabantu bonna, gwe musingi gw'eddembe; obwenkanya n'emirembe mu nsi.

folded.id: oguliko ekibonerezo|ateekwa|okubalibwa nga taliiko musango okutuusa nga kikakasibbwanti ddala yaguzza okusinziira mu mateeka era ateekwa okuwozesebwa mu kooti mu lwatu nga aweereddwa na buli mukisa gwonna okwetaasa
folded.subject: oguliko ekibonerezo
folded.object: okubalibwa nga taliiko musango okutuusa nga kikakasibbwanti ddala yaguzza okusinziira mu mateeka era ateekwa okuwozesebwa mu kooti mu lwatu nga aweereddwa na buli mukisa gwonna okwetaasa

spans.text: Buli muntu yenna avunaanibwa omusango oguliko ekibonerezo ateekwa okubalibwa nga taliiko musango okutuusa nga kikakasibbwanti ddala yaguzza okusinziira mu mateeka era ateekwa okuwozesebwa mu kooti mu lwatu nga aweereddwa na buli mukisa gwonna okwetaasa.

folded.id: okufuluma okuva|mu|ggwanga lyona
folded.subject: okufuluma okuva

spans.text: Buli muntu wa ddembe okufuluma okuva mu ggwanga lyona, kino nga kitwaliramu n'eggwanga lye, wamu n'okudda mu ggwanga lye.

folded.id: okunoonya obubudamo|mu|ggwanga eddala era n'okusanyukira mu bubudamo obwo
folded.subject: okunoonya obubudamo
folded.object: ggwanga eddala era n'okusanyukira mu bubudamo obwo

spans.text: Omuntu ayigganyizibwa waddembe okunoonya obubudamo mu ggwanga eddala era n'okusanyukira mu bubudamo obwo.

folded.id: okusinziira|mu|mateeka g'eggwanga eryo oba ag'amawanga amalala bwanabanga ateekwa okubonerezebwa mu kiseera weyazziza omusango ogwo
folded.subject: okusinziira
folded.object: mateeka g'eggwanga eryo oba ag'amawanga amalala Bwanabanga ateekwa okubonerezebwa mu kiseera weyazziza omusango ogwo

spans.text: Tewali muntu n'omu anabalibwanga nga azzizza omusango ogumubonerezesa, kino nga kisinzira kukikolwa kye yakola oba kyatakola, mu kiseera ekyemabega, kyokka nga mu kiseera ekyo ekikolwa kyeyakola oba kyeyalemwa okukola kyali tekittekwa kumubonerezesa, okusinziira mu mateeka g'eggwanga eryo oba ag'amawanga amalala Bwanabanga ateekwa okubonerezebwa mu kiseera weyazziza omusango ogwo.

folded.id: okuyita|mu|kukola kw'eggwanga lye oba okukolagana n'awamanga nga amalala
folded.subject: okuyita
folded.object: kukola kw'eggwanga lye oba okukolagana n'awamanga nga amalala

spans.text: Kino kimusobozese okutuuka ku biruubirirwa eby'ekitiibwa by'obuntun'okulongongoosa empisa ze, okuyita mu kukola kw'eggwanga lye oba okukolagana n'awamanga nga amalala, okusinziira ku nteekateeka n'enkozesa 'obugagga bwe'eggwanga mu by'enfuna, ey'embeera z'abantu n'eby'obuwangwa ebitayinza kwewalika mu kukulakulana kuno.

folded.id: olukiiko|ttabamiruka|(general assembly) olw'amawanga amagatte
folded.subject: Olukiiko

spans.text: Olwekyo, Olukiiko ttabamiruka (General Assembly) olw'amawanga Amagatte, iulangirira Ekirangiriro EKIFUGA EDDEMBE LY'ABANTU BONNA WONNA MU NSI.

folded.id: olwekyo abantu|ne|gavumenti basaanye okugakuuma obutiribiri
folded.subject: olwekyo abantu

spans.text: Amaka gwe musingi gw'eggwanga ogw'obuwangwa olwekyo abantu ne gavumenti basaanye okugakuuma obutiribiri.

folded.id: onuyinza obumuweebwa|mu|mateeka singa waliwo omusango ogumenya amateeka ogumuvunaanibwa
folded.subject: onuyinza obumuweebwa
folded.object: mateeka singa waliwo omusango ogumenya amateeka ogumuvunaanibwa

spans.text: Buli muntu awatali kusosola, ateekwa okuwozesebwa mu lwatu ate mu bwenkanya mu kooti eyeemala era eterina kyekubira, bwabanga annonya okukakasa onuyinza obumuweebwa mu mateeka singa waliwo omusango ogumenya amateeka ogumuvunaanibwa.

folded.id: taakomerwenga|mu|ngeri yenna obutawasa oba okufumbirirwa n'okuzaala abaana
folded.subject: taakomerwenga
folded.object: ngeri yenna obutawasa oba okufumbirirwa n'okuzaala abaana

spans.text: Omusajja oba omukazi omukulu atuuse okwesalirawo, taakomerwenga mu ngeri yenna obutawasa oba okufumbirirwa n'okuzaala abaana, olw'olulyo mwasibuka, olw'eggwanga lye oba lwe'eddini ye.

folded.id: waddembe okwetaba|mu|nfuga y'eggwenga lye
folded.subject: waddembe okwetaba

spans.text: Buli muntu waddembe okwetaba mu nfuga y'eggwenga lye.

folded.id: wamu n'okudda|mu|ggwanga lye
folded.subject: wamu n'okudda

spans.text: Buli muntu wa ddembe okufuluma okuva mu ggwanga lyona, kino nga kitwaliramu n'eggwanga lye, wamu n'okudda mu ggwanga lye.
